messages:
From: ClearSpring Security <security@clearspring.com>

Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@clearspring.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Vendr profile owner onboarding + SOC2 artifacts

Hi Naomi,

Per our procurement flow we’re ready to put ClearSpring’s security profile into Vendr and need help with two things on Redwood’s side:

1) A named steward (delegated owner) we can assign in Vendr so uploads and Q&A are routed to the right person.
2) Confirmation of the minimal evidence set Redwood can accept via the Vendr upload (we prefer presigned manifests for large artifacts).

We can provide: SOC2 Type II (2027), system architecture, and a CSV manifest of artifacts. A couple questions from our side: do you require a signed attestation for SOC2 possession? And what is the preferred TTL for presigned uploads?

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-2027.pdf (stub), vendr-presign-manifest.csv (stub)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

—Ben (on behalf of ClearSpring security)
Ben Liu
Security Operations
ClearSpring Inc.
security@clearspring.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: ClearSpring Security <security@clearspring.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Vendr profile owner onboarding + SOC2 artifacts

Hi Ben / Alice,

Thanks — this is exactly the info we need to get moving. Quick answers up front:
- We don’t require a separate signed attestation beyond the SOC2 report itself, but we do request a short possession statement in the portal (one-line).
- Presigned upload TTL: 48 hours is preferred for large bundles; we can accept up to 7 days for scheduled bulk migrations with prior notice.

Next steps I propose (mutual action plan):
1) ClearSpring creates the Vendr profile and uploads the manifest (you already have the CSV, great).
2) Redwood assigns a named steward in Vendr (please confirm who at Redwood should be shown as the contact).
3) ClearSpring uploads artifacts to the presigned URL and adds a one-line attestation in the Q&A item.
4) We run a short verification pass (files + basic checks) and close the intake.

Marissa — can you be the delegated Vendr steward for this account? Jonas, loop in if you want to handle the verification.

Also attaching a short onboarding checklist we use for Vendr profile handoffs. I’ll create the Vendr steward record once Marissa confirms.

Attachments: vendr-onboard-checklist.pdf (internal stub)

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Manager, Security Intake
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Alice Park <alice.park@clearspring.com>

Date: Wed, 02 Mar 2028 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Vendr profile owner onboarding + SOC2 artifacts

Hi Naomi — thanks for the fast reply.

We’ll proceed with the manifest upload today. A couple clarifications:
- We will add the one-line possession attestation to the Q&A item (“ClearSpring confirms possession of the SOC2 Type II report referenced”).
- We’ll request 72-hour presign TTL for the initial bundle (contains multiple 250–500MB logs).

I’ve attached the architecture diagram you asked about. For the steward contact in Vendr please use the display name: "Redwood Security (Marissa Cole)" and the email marissa.cole@redwood.com — that will route notifications directly.

We’ve also included a short CSV that maps artifact filenames to CAIQ/SIG questions in our intake system (vendr-presign-manifest.csv).

Attachments: clearspring-arch-diagram-2028.pdf (stub), vendr-presign-manifest.csv (stub)

If Marissa can confirm she’s comfortable receiving portal notifications and running the verification, we’ll mark the task done and upload tonight.

Best,

Marissa — thanks for confirming by chat earlier; this is a formal note to confirm Redwood will be the Vendr steward as requested.

Action items we’re taking now:
- I created the Vendr steward record "Redwood Security (Marissa Cole)" and sent the delegated invite — screenshot attached (vendr-delegation-invite-screenshot.png).
- Jonas will run the verification pass once ClearSpring completes the upload (expect basic filename/manifest checks + ensure attestation present).
- Presign TTL approved for 72 hours for this initial upload; please flag if you need extended window and we’ll approve on a case-by-case basis.
- After verification we’ll mark the intake as complete and link the artifacts to the Redwood security profile (internal governance).

Marissa — please confirm when you’ve accepted the Vendr invite and are set to review tonight. I’ll update HubSpot deal HS-4782 to reflect the intake state.

Thanks everyone — nice, quick flow.
